Should you rise to their challenge, you will have Glimmith's unwavering regard.

<b>Respected Artisan,</>

    The areas ahead contain a vast collection of glasswork designs. But fear not! You need only complete a fraction of them to restore the windows.
<red>If ambition beckons, complete more glassworks to metallicize the frames and reveal extra challenges.</>
If you thoroughly master an area, its frame will become gilded.

<red>This area is optional.</>

<b>Dearest Esteemed Artisan,</>

    Thank you for accepting my invitation to restore the artworks of Glimmith.

On that point, I have only one request.
<red>When shaping each piece of glass, you must follow the rules very closely!</>
I care only about the shapes. Let your creativity run free with the colors!

<b>Dearest Artisan,</>

    I hope this letter finds you in the best of spirits and creative fervor!

There is much work to be done...
<red>These window frames show your restoration progress.</>
Each glasswork you restore contributes to a window. Complete windows to progress onward.

<h1>Challenge Ahead!</>

Difficulty 5-6 puzzles are <b>very challenging</>.

They may require careful logic, advanced techniques, and lots of persistence.

Early "break-in" steps may be difficult to spot.

These puzzles are <b>optional</>. Feel free to come back later if you get stuck.

<h1>Extra puzzles</>

Some areas have more puzzles than necessary to gild the window.

You do not need to find them all.

Later, you will discover the true number of puzzles and a way to locate every last one.

<h1>Extreme Challenge Ahead!</>

Difficulty 7 is the highest in the game. These puzzles are <b>diabolically tough</>.

We recommend saving them until you've completed most of the game.

As you gain experience, you'll learn subtle tricks to help overcome them.

<h1>Note what you know</>

The key to success in trickier puzzles is <b>marking down partial progress</>!

Merge cells when you know they belong to the same region. Draw borders when you know they exist.

Do this immediately, even if you don't know the full shape of a region.

Filling in the facts will reveal new ways to make further progress, until the puzzle is complete.

<h1>Secret puzzles</>

Some puzzles are tucked away in hidden locations.

They are totally optional.

Later, you will discover a way to find puzzles that you missed.
